name: powerbi-desktop
description: Guided Power BI workflows from data sources to trusted decisions, safe PBIP changes, release, and Fabric operations.

interface.shortDescription: Guided Power BI workflows from data to trusted decisions.
interface.longDescription: Start with one outcome: build a model from data sources, trust KPIs, change PBIP safely, release with confidence, operate Fabric, or govern decisions. The plugin routes to a focused workflow and keeps PBIX binaries untouched. Live and Fabric access are read-only by default.
defaultPrompt: What can you do with this Power BI plugin?
Build a Power BI model from these data sources.
Can I trust this report for a decision?
